title: Can I SURVIVE MORE Dice Chess?
summary: Dice Chess vs only higher-rated opponents (incl. a 2200) at 1+1 to lift his regular dice rating (~1500) toward his 'doubles' rating; wins three games (+~35 rating).
rules: Each turn roll 3 dice; each die face is a piece type (pawn, knight, bishop, rook, queen, king).
Make up to 3 moves in your turn, one per die, each with a piece of the rolled type; unusable dice are skipped; the same piece may use several dice of its type (e.g. king+rook rolled lets you castle).
No check/checkmate: capturing the enemy king wins.
Promotion to any piece (choosing the type matters because of dice; he promotes to a bishop to use a double-bishop roll).
'Doubles' mode mentioned: a doubling option (x2 / infinity-die icon) forces the opponent to gamble twice the rating stake (he usually plays doubles; this video is regular).
win_condition: Capture the enemy king. Goal: 3 wins vs higher-rated players (achieved).

board.theme_notes: brown/tan board; three red piece dice; ROLL button; YOU WIN +2.73 popup; doubling-cube style infinity die icon (sprite dwiAKx06Q9E_infinity_die.png)

current_impl_issues: Legacy 'two dice' - should be three dice, up to 3 moves, king capture.
